description: This file defines the UserSaveHandler class responsible for handling User object save operations within the OpenMRS framework. It ensures system IDs are generated for new users and manages lazy-loaded Hibernate collections.

classes.name: UserSaveHandler
classes.description: Handles saving of User objects, generating system IDs, and loading Hibernate collections for related Person objects.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main method invoked to process a User object before saving, ensures it has a system ID and loads necessary collections.

methods.name: loadLazyHibernateCollections
methods.description: Helper method to load Hibernate collections lazily for User's person property, specifically if the person is a Patient.
